newsitem.title: JAPAN: Olympic Sports says to file for bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Sports says to file for bankruptcy.

text.p: Olympic Sports Co said it had decided to apply to the Nagoya District Court for bankruptcy later on Wednesday.

The company, which operates sporting goods shops and fitness clubs, said in a statement that it had applied for court mediation with creditors in September, but had been unable to draw up a reorganisation scheme.
The company said it has debt totalling 35.6 billion yen.
The Japan Securities Dealers Association said earlier that trading in the company's shares will be temporarily suspended on the over-the-counter market on Wednesday.
